summary: Execute final system closure and pre-Go-Live product closure: tenant entry, company-scoped administrator authorization, stable API error mapping, operational Arabic workspaces, accounting and tourism closure, production frontend builds, secure backup/recovery, deployment evidence, regression and UAT readiness.
protectedReason: Owner-authorized final system closure includes the canonical company-scoped Username authentication design and the final Product UI closure required for client delivery. Platform Core remains the sole identity/authorization owner; the canonical company-administrator role has full capability access only inside its assigned company while ordinary roles remain explicit-permission scoped. Protected navigation changes keep operational workspaces in the primary sidebar while moving record-detail (360/program workspace) and account settings to contextual flows. API PlatformError mapping converts domain authorization failures to stable HTTP semantics, and the Arabic UI presents controlled permission/session feedback instead of raw server errors. The same pre-Go-Live scope retains the previously approved SAAS migration repair and Hajj/Umrah runtime corrections. Owner-authorized AE-01 architecture enforcement adds fail-closed anti-patching, CI self-check, protected verification scripts, mandatory changed-test evidence, and an immutable exact-blob lock for the one-time pre-Go-Live SAAS migration repair. Final corrective closure also makes General Ledger journal evidence branch-owned, enforces branch-safe Accounting Workspace reads/mutations, preserves explicit posted-invoice settlement intent through Treasury/Billing, routes general-tourism cancellation through canonical Tourism Finance Orchestration, and removes the obsolete public email-recovery tenant surface in favor of the approved Company Code + Username credential flow. Production runtime closure also replaces the TypeScript source loader with a compiled-JavaScript deployment artifact: all workspace packages are built, their production artifact exports are fail-closed validated against dist files, and the API starts from apps/api/dist/main.js.
publicApiBreakingReason: Owner-authorized pre-Go-Live tenant authentication contract change: /saas/login moves from Company Code + email + password to Company Code + company-scoped username + password. The staging system is not yet closed/merged for production, and existing database users receive additive backfilled company login identities.
unacceptedMigrationRepairReason: PR #81 merged SAAS-01 before Go-Live, but the fresh-database Railway drill proved this migration is syntactically unexecutable because two currency CHECK expressions were corrupted by injected SELECT text. The repair is limited to restoring the intended three-uppercase-letter currency constraints so the accepted schema can be created on a clean database; no historical business data or accepted runtime behavior is rewritten.
